Software Engineer Intern

Ramp
New York, NY

About the job

You will own the ledger service end to end: the double-entry core, the reconciliation jobs that run against it nightly, and the APIs the rest of the product builds on. This is production work from week one, not a side project.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship services in Go against Postgres.
  • Own correctness: property tests, invariants, and reconciliation checks.
  • Work directly with the payments team on the ledger's public API.

What we look for

  • Coursework or projects in distributed systems or databases.
  • Comfort reading code you did not write.
